title: Documentation plugin
summary: In-admin developer handbook. This plugin registers the Documentation admin site and loads articles from every plugin docs/ folder, including its own.
configure: Admin, Documentation. Configure on the plugins list deep-links here. There is no settings form.
preferences: None. Use this site, not a Preferences dump.

sections.heading: How this plugin registers the docs site
paragraphs: kind is docs. provides AdminPage. adminNav item pluginId docs-developer, group standalone (top of the sidebar, above Accueil, no group label). Front route /admin/docs (and /admin/docs/:articleId) gates with usePluginEnabled("docs-developer"). GET /admin/docs requires the same plugin effectively on, else 404 plugin_disabled.
The page is a small website: sticky nav, search, grouped articles. It is not a markdown dump in a modal.

sections.heading: How other plugins contribute articles
paragraphs: Drop docs/handbook.json in the plugin folder (identity, Configure, openings, cart/order/profile). Optional docs/articles.json adds extra pages with group "core", "examples", or "plugin:<id>". buildDocsSite reads every installed plugin folder. Disable a plugin and its group stays listed but marked disabled.
This plugin contributes the Core handbook and Worked examples via docs/articles.json, plus this page via handbook.json.
